commons.title: Scarred tree Fitzroy Gardens.jpg
commons.credit: The original uploader was Tirin at English Wikipedia.
commons.description:
Scarred tree in the en:Fitzroy Gardens, Melbourne
The plaque to this tree says:

Scarred Tree
The scar on this tree was created when Aboriginal people removed bark to make canoes, shields, food and water containers, string, baby carriers and other items.
Please respect this site. It is important to the en:Wurundjeri people as traditional custodians of the land and is part of the heritage of all Australians.
All Aboriginal cultural sites are protected by law.
Photo by Takver and released under GNU GFDL
commons.editorial_reason: The scarred tree and plaque explicitly identify its cultural importance to Wurundjeri and its use for making Aboriginal objects.
